logline: A ruthlessly ambitious prosecutor suffers a catastrophic accident that leaves him with a child's mind and paralysis, forcing a painful - and eventually tender - re-bonding with the harsh mother who made him.

renewal.note: 14-episode limited series on JTBC, airing April 26 to June 8, 2023. Concluded as a single complete story with no sequel planned.

bollymeter.basis: Set records for JTBC Wednesday-Thursday drama ratings and became one of the highest-rated series in Korean cable history, with Ra Mi-ran delivering a widely acclaimed performance and the writing sustaining both comedy and grief across 14 episodes.

seasons.review_body: The Good Bad Mother aired on JTBC from April to June 2023 and set new cable rating records for the network's Wednesday-Thursday slot - making it one of the highest-rated Korean cable dramas of 2023. The premise is structurally audacious: Lee Do-hyun plays a successful prosecutor who, following a violent accident, regresses to the mental age of a child while remaining physically adult. His mother, played by Ra Mi-ran, must raise him again, this time without the ambition that distorted their relationship the first time. Ra Mi-ran's performance - rigorous, unsentimental, and ultimately devastating - was cited across Korean press coverage as the season's anchor. The show balances tonal registers that should not coexist - rural comedy, traumatic flashback, gentle rehabilitation - and does so without obvious seams. Lee Do-hyun is persuasive playing childlike innocence inside an adult frame. The 14-episode run is tight, emotionally calibrated, and earns its catharsis. No professional English-language Rotten Tomatoes critic sample was available at time of writing.
